title: Department of Rural Development Celebrates International Day of Yoga 2026; Secretary Shri Rohit Kansal Leads Yoga Session at Kartavya Bhavan
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Rural Development

Department of Rural Development Celebrates International Day of Yoga 2026; Secretary Shri Rohit Kansal Leads Yoga Session at Kartavya Bhavan

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
21 JUN 2026 8:00PM by PIB Delhi

The International Day of Yoga (IDY) 2026 was celebrated with enthusiasm at Kartavya Bhavan-03, New Delhi, under the theme "Yoga for Healthy Ageing." The event was jointly organized by the Ministry of Rural Development, Ministry of Home Affairs, Department of Personnel and Training, Ministry of External Affairs, and the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser, Government of India.

Shri Rohit Kansal, Secretary, Department of Rural Development, led the Department's participation in the programme along with other senior officers.

Secretary, Department of Rural Development, Shri Rohit Kansal participated in the programme and highlighted the significance of yoga as a holistic practice for physical fitness, mental well-being, and emotional balance. He encouraged officers and staff to adopt yoga as part of their daily routine for a healthier and more productive lifestyle.

The programme highlighted the importance of yoga in promoting a healthy lifestyle and holistic well-being. The observance reflected the Government's continued commitment to encouraging preventive healthcare and fostering physical and mental wellness among its workforce.

During the event, trained yoga instructors guided participants through various yoga asanas and breathing exercises, demonstrating techniques that promote flexibility, concentration, and overall well-being. Participants were sensitized to the role of yoga in enhancing physical fitness, reducing stress, improving mental health, and boosting productivity.

The programme was attended by Shri T.K. Anil Kumar, Additional Secretary; Shri Piyush Srivastava, Senior Economic Adviser; Ms. Swati Sharma, Ms. Rohini R. Bhajibhakare, Ms. Jayasree M. G., and Shri Lal Chhandama, Joint Secretaries, Department of Rural Development. A large number of officers and staff members of the Department also participated in the event, reaffirming their commitment to wellness, healthy living, and holistic development.

आज कर्तव्य भवन, नई दिल्ली में अंतरराष्ट्रीय योग दिवस के अवसर पर आयोजित कार्यक्रम में श्री रोहित कंसल, सचिव, ग्रामीण विकास विभाग के साथ विभाग के अधिकारियों एवं कर्मचारियों ने उत्साहपूर्वक भाग लिया।
